title: Collateral Murder - Wikileaks - Iraq
summary: WikiLeaks' release of cockpit footage from a 2007 US Apache helicopter attack in Baghdad that killed a group of men including two Reuters staff, and then a van that came to help the wounded. The video includes the crew's radio chatter and context on the military's initial account.
why: HN cites it as the key evidence of what Chelsea Manning leaked and as an example of civilian deaths in war, with some early commenters disputing how to read the footage.

quote.text: For those unfamiliar with the still unprosecuted war crimes exposed by Manning (and published by Assange)
